professional_identity.summary: Senior WordPress Developer with nearly 6 years of end-to-end ownership across 620+ production sites, from server configuration and custom plugin architecture to client delivery, team leadership and mentoring. At Certinal (a Zycus company) I led the WordPress-to-Astro migration of the 1,640-page certinal.com, built with Claude Code and kept reliable by systems I engineered for AI-assisted development: a hook-driven project-memory system, 33 build and deploy check scripts, a 29-check smoke test and multi-agent review workflows. I implemented WCAG accessibility on the site, built its HubSpot lead forms and set up its trunk-based dev-to-production pipeline on Sevalla. I also build Claude Code plugins, Agent Skills and MCP servers, automate WordPress through the Elementor MCP and Novamira, and fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B locally on Apple Silicon for agentic WordPress development. Earlier work spans raw-API payment gateways, WooCommerce subscription engines, dynamic PDF systems for a UK bank, CRM integrations and performance work that improved Core Web Vitals by 40–60%.
professional_identity.summary_resume: Senior WordPress Developer with nearly 6 years delivering 620+ sites across WordPress, Webflow, Shopify and other platforms, specializing in PHP custom themes and custom plugins, WooCommerce, payment and CRM API integrations, security hardening and Core Web Vitals, with team leadership and mentoring experience. At Certinal (a Zycus company; consent and eSignature SaaS for India's DPDP Act), led the WordPress-to-Astro migration of the 1,640-page marketing site, implemented WCAG accessibility on it and manages it through Claude Code and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

case_study.problem: A large WordPress/Elementor marketing site had to move to a fast static stack without losing a single URL, document or form, and the work had to stay reliable across months of AI-assisted development.
approach: Wrote a transform that converts the WordPress export into per-post block JSON and serves every migrated post at its exact old URL through 10 layouts.
Built a Claude Code project-memory system (CLAUDE.md, 9 rules, a 545-row symptom index injected by hooks, blocking pre-commit gates) so long sessions neither forget nor invent facts.
Gated every build and deploy with 33 check scripts, each negative-tested against a real silent failure, and a 29-check smoke test against the deployed app.

results: 1,640 pages built from 1,464 migrated documents, now live on certinal.com

Always-loaded context cut from about 129k to 65k tokens
29 of 29 post-deploy smoke checks passing before cutover

projects.title: Claude Code Project-Memory System
projects.description: A memory system that keeps long Claude Code sessions accurate on a large codebase: a root CLAUDE.md, 9 always-loaded rule files, a numbered change log and a 545-row symptom index kept out of context but injected by a retrieval script running as two Claude Code hooks; a blocking pre-commit hook refuses code commits that update no documentation.

projects.title: AI Outreach Automation System
projects.description: A Claude plugin (Agent Skill playbook, 3 slash commands, 5 reference files) and an 11-tool MCP server packaged as an MCP Bundle that automate a magazine's sample-for-review outreach: finding brands, discovering published contacts, writing personal emails in 6 languages, sending from a shared mailbox and triaging replies.

Enforced guardrails in code rather than prompts: a shared rolling 24-hour send cap, duplicate and do-not-contact checks, a past-coverage lookup through the WordPress REST API, on-page address verification, SSRF protection and prompt-injection defense that treats email and web text as untrusted data.

Implemented SMTP/IMAP automation with reserve-first, timeout-safe sending, 8-category reply triage with load-balanced assignment, robots.txt-compliant contact discovery and personal emails in 6 languages; validated with 20 unit tests and 6 end-to-end test-mode rehearsals.
